name: Cyberpunk Heist
description: A cyberpunk hacker card game where you infiltrate corporate servers, dodge ICE programs, and steal data.

playRule.description: Attempt to breach a server by comparing attack to ICE defense. If successful, draw a 'data_fragment' card from the 'data_bank'.
Attempt to breach a server with increased attack. Effective against 'firewall_card'.
Negate a single 'ice_card' or 'firewall_card' protecting a server. Remove the targeted ICE.
Place this card in an empty ICE slot on a 'server'.
Place this card in an empty ICE slot on a 'server'. Stronger against 'exploit_card' attempts.
Place this card in an empty ICE slot on a 'server'. If breached, deals damage to the Hacker's programs.

entities.name: Corporate Data Bank
entities.description: Source of 'data_fragment' cards when servers are successfully breached.

entities.name: Collected Data
entities.description: Area where the Hacker stores collected data fragments.

rules.description: At the start of their turn, players draw 1 card from their respective decks.
rules.actionDescription: Draws 1 card from the player's primary deck.

rules.description: The Hacker can play a 'program' card (e.g., 'access_card', 'exploit_card', 'bypass_card') from their hand to target a 'server' entity.
rules.actionDescription: Initiates a server breach attempt as per the played card's 'playRule'.

rules.description: The Corporation can play a 'defense' card (e.g., 'ice_card', 'firewall_card', 'black_ice_card') from their hand to an empty 'iceSlot' on a 'server' entity.
rules.actionDescription: Places the played 'defense' card onto the targeted 'server' entity's 'defendingIce' array.

rules.description: When a 'program' card attempts to breach a server, compare its 'attack' value to the 'defense' of the 'ice_card' defending the server. If 'attack' >= 'defense', the ICE is bypassed. If bypassed, the ICE is discarded. If not, the Hacker's program might be discarded.
rules.actionDescription: Resolves the interaction between Hacker's 'program' and Corporation's 'defense' on a 'server'.

rules.description: If a server breach successfully bypasses all ICE and reduces the server's 'currentData' to 0, the 'hacker' steals 'data_fragment' cards from the 'data_bank' up to the server's 'dataCapacity', moving them to 'hacker_collected_data_zone'.
Hacker wins if they collect 5 data fragments.
Corporation loses if all servers are drained of data.
